status: FROZEN BEFORE EXPANDED COHORT OUTCOME EVALUATION

primary_prospect_outcomes.definition: Preserve Phase1 five-calendar-year realized-production labels and numeric thresholds; primary is comparable but inherits reduced-category limitations. No lifetime bust claims.
primary_prospect_outcomes.regular: At least two seasons with >=250 AB or >=40 IP
primary_prospect_outcomes.peak: Mean of two highest actual annual Phase1 intrinsic scores in evaluation year through year+4, missing years zero
primary_prospect_outcomes.delayed_arrival_secondary: Seven-year labels only for cohorts ending by 2025, reported separately; do not substitute extended labels for training five-year primary
primary_prospect_outcomes.career: Observed through 2025; never label all records complete careers without verified retirement/death evidence

cohorts.development: Dated preseason rankings through 2015. One record per person for primary training; all source/year records retained for coverage.
cohorts.final_validation: 2020 preseason, exclude identities seen in development; outcomes through 2024. Do not inspect final labels until protocol, identities, features and models are frozen.
cohorts.additional_reserve: 2021 preseason reserved, do not collect labels or evaluate this pass.
cohorts.previously_exposed: 2017/2018 cohort outcomes and 2019 real-world MLB records already available in prior checkpoint; never describe them as untouched confirmation. 2019 list used for trajectory only.

models.baseline: Multinomial L2 logistic, C=.3, max_iter2000; log(rank), stable DOB age, pitcher/hitter role
models.features: Predeclared separate additions: dated FV; harmonized future hit/game-power/run or FB/breaking/control grades where comparable; predecessor ranking and FV trajectory; dated level; prior-year MiLB stats; dated injury indicators. Missing evidence stays missing with flags. Compare on matched IDs/source coverage; no model chosen for best holdout.
models.uncertainty: Identity-level development bootstrap500, 90% probability bands, empirical Wilson95% tail rates; paired final Brier bootstrap2000. Report missing-class bootstrap exclusions.
models.no_tuning: Never optimize thresholds or utility toward named trades or final validation labels. Model failures and unavailable features reported.

categories.QA3: An appearance qualifies iff outs>=15 and ER<=2 OR outs>=18 and ER<=3, no conventional QS substitution. Aggregate appearances by player+game before thresholding; starter flag not required by supplied definition.
hitting: team OBP + team SLG from component counts
categories.eligibility: 35 IP per 7-day scoring period, prorated for length; failing minimum loses all pitching categories. Daily lineups; P slots6-9, 22active max, H positions as rules source; full optimization deferred.
categories.contribution_diagnostics: Exact weekly category functions plus fixed legal-roster contextual marginal category-point simulations. Contexts frozen from 2010-2012 or prior-year performance/eligibility, not selecting each week's best players. This is hypothetical context, not observed league outcomes.
categories.replacement: Separate signed replacement comparisons, never subtract into intrinsic labels or value unowned access as known. Current ownership/acquisition/roster optimizer deferred.

architecture: Nonlinear utility E[U(contribution)] once per outcome per asset, not U(package total), no scarcity/roster/replacement bonuses duplicated. THEN/NOW/REALIZED separated; completed trades not fair targets.
explanation: Offline text renderer uses separate owner horizons, numeric direction and uncertainty; no generic fairness verdict and no production editing.

pre_final_label_addendum.reason: First-occurrence-only 2015 feature subsample lacked all five outcome classes before final labels were accessed. Matched feature diagnostics use full 2015 top100, one record per ID, all inside development identities; primary expanded baseline remains first appearance. No final labels accessed or feature selected based on validation.
pre_final_label_addendum.matched_absent_classes: Full 2015 dated-grade training may lack superclass labels. Align observed class predictions to five classes with zero absent-class probability, report failure/coverage, never synthesize superstar cases. This is an explicit weakness, not a valid upper-tail FV calibration.
